caption: Pro stores a named watch profile for a project review.
eval: (async () => { app.plugins.plugins['property-change-ledger'].closeModal(); app.setting.close();const p = app.plugins.plugins['property-change-ledger']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('property-change-ledger-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow();p.settings.profiles = []; await p.saveProfile('Project review'); app.commands.executeCommandById('property-change-ledger:configure-watch'); return 'ok'; })()
